lines.en: What would you like to say?
: {i}What the fuck is happening IN THE BACKGROUND?{/i}
: {i}I was too focused on how I looked that I didn’t even realize they were in the picture{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我太在意自己好不好看了，压根没注意到他们也在画面里{/i}

lines.en: : {i}MY DAY? I am marrying your sister TOMORROW.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我今天？我明天就要娶你姐姐了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Are you fucking kidding me right now???{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你现在是在他妈的跟我开玩笑吗？？？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Do what? I just wanted to send you a cute selfie :3{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}做什么？我只是想给你发张可爱的自拍 :3{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I can’t believe she’s cheating on me. What the fuck???{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我真不敢相信她居然出轨了。什么鬼？？？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I meannnnn I wouldn’t say it’s CHEATING.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我的意思是eeeeee，我也不会说这算「出轨」。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}She’s jussssssst...........celebrating her bachelorette party with her whole heart <3{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她只iiiiiiii是在……全心全意地庆祝她的单身派对 <3{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And I mean her WHOLE heart because she’s been getting passed around like crazy lmao{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而且我说的是「全心全意」，因为她正被人传来传去，传得可疯了哈哈哈{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Mom too. Which is why I’m so boredddddddddd and why you should keep me company :D{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}妈妈也是。所以我才超级超级无聊，你该来陪陪我才对 :D{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I had a sex dream about you last night, you know!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我昨晚做了个关于你的春梦，你知道吗！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}A good one too. I needed to get it all out of my system before you marry Nee-sama.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而且是个好梦。在你娶姐姐大人之前，我得把这些全都从身体里清掉。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The wedding is off. I don’t want to be a part of this anymore.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}婚礼取消。我不想再掺和这事了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Stop texting me. I can’t do this.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别再发短信给我了。我受不了了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Didn’t you sleep with like every one of her friends?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你不是跟她那帮朋友差不多每一个都睡过吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That was YEARS ago!!! I gave them all up for her!!!!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那都是好几年以前的事了！！！我为了她把她们全放弃了！！！！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And this is just one day! Who cares lol{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而且这才一天而已！谁在乎啊 哈哈{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Tsukasa??? What the fuck was the supposed to mean???{/i}

lines.zh: : {i}Touka 会杀了我啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What is going on with you right now???{/i}
: {i}Who the fuck is that in the background?!{/i}
: {i}I didn’t even notice they were in the picture hahahahh{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我压根没注意到他们也在画面里 hahahahh{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Just some new staff members! Nothing you need to be worried about, future brother-in-law <3{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}只是些新来的工作人员！没什么好担心的，未来的姐夫 <3{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Why? They don’t even speak Japanese lol{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？他们连日语都不会说 哈哈{/i}

lines.en: : {i}So her heart will always belong to you!! <3333{/i}
: {i}Just be happy you finally get to see me topless :X{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你就该高兴点，终于能看到我上半身全裸的样子了 :X{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I know you’ve wanted to for years :P{/i}
: {i}Wanted to give you a present before you get married tomorrow :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}想在明天你结婚之前送你一份礼物 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}The wedding is off. I can’t do this.{/i}
: {i}Okaaaaaay hold on hold on hold on. Don’t get hasty, big bro!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好————吧等等等等等等。别冲动啊，大哥！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}This was all my mom’s idea. Nee-sama was actually SUPER against it at first.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这全是我妈的主意。姐姐大人一开始可是超级反对的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I had to basically like persuade her to go through with it lol. She’s a hard nut to crack!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我基本上是硬说服她才让她答应的 哈哈。她可真难搞定！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I bet she’d thank me now, though. These guys are like machines :o{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过我猜她现在大概会谢我。这些家伙简直像机器一样 :o{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I just gave her a push because I don’t want her living with any regrets!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我只是推了她一把，因为我不想让她带着任何遗憾过日子！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’m sorry if you have a problem with it :({/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果你对此有意见，我很抱歉 :({/i}

lines.en: : {i}OF COURSE I HAVE A PROBLEM WITH IT{/i}
: {i}Well, if it makes you happy, I’m just hanging out on the sidelines! :D{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，要是这能让你好受点，我就只是在旁边看着而已！:D{/i}

lines.en: : {i}There was one guy who kept trying to fuck me but I was like sorry nope my heart belongs to someone else <3{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}有个家伙一直想操我，可我就说抱歉不行，我的心已经属于别人了 <3{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I am clearly the superior choice if I am the one abstaining from sexual intercourse right now to talk to you!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}要是此刻为了跟你说话而忍着不做爱的人是我，那我明显才是更好的选择！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I may have even exposed a dark secret you’d have never known about otherwise! :3{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}说不定我还抖出了一个你否则永远都不会知道的黑暗秘密！:3{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Maaaaaaybe one you could give me in person? That’d definitely give Nee-sama the shock of her life LOL{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}也————许你可以当面给我？那绝对能让姐姐大人吓到魂飞魄散哈哈哈{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If she’s even conscious enough to see you by then. This guy’s really going to town on her :o{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果到那时候她还有意识看得见你的话。这家伙正对她大干特干呢 :o{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Stop texting me, Tsukasa. I’m turning my phone off.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别再发短信给我了，Tsukasa。我要关机了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But if I don’t have you to talk to, I might need to resort to other methods to keep myself from being bored D:{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可要是没你陪我说话，我可能就得用别的办法来排解无聊了 D:{/i}

lines.en: : {i}There are like three guys jerking off to me right now. Idk where Mom finds perverts like these.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}现在大概有三个家伙正对着我打飞机。我都不知道妈是从哪儿找来这些变态的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Wouldn’t you feel bad knowing they were taking turns with me like they are with Nee-sama? I’m the innocent one :3{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}要是知道他们像轮姐姐大人那样轮我，你心里不会过意不去吗？我可是无辜的那个 :3{/i}

lines.en: : {i}There’s nothing innocent about this and you know it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这事一点都不无辜，你心里清楚。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You wanted to ruin my life and now you have. Congratulations. Goodbye.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你想毁掉我的人生，现在你做到了。恭喜你。再见。{/i}
: {i}你真是个他妈的怂包哈哈哈{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Fine. “Turn off your phone.” But we both know you’re going right to the bathroom to jerk off to this.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}行。「关机」吧。可我们俩都清楚，你马上就会冲进厕所对着这些打飞机。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Wonder what’ll be happening to me by thennnnn :3{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不知道到时候我会被怎么对待呢eeee :3{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Last chance to come claim me before they do!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}最后的机会，在他们之前来占有我！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I didn’t realize they were in the picture D:{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我没注意到他们也在画面里 D:{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I just wanted to send you something cute!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我只是想给你发点可爱的东西！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Nee-sama would kill me if she found out :x{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}要是被姐姐大人知道，她会杀了我的 :x{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I just said it was an accident! Have I ever lied to you before?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我都说了是不小心的！我以前骗过你吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Not that I know of? At least not with Nee-sama.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就我所知没有？至少跟姐姐大人之间没有。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Mom gets run down by these guys every week I imagine lmao.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我猜妈每周都要被这些家伙弄得筋疲力尽吧哈哈哈。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Most of them are new, though. I think she got them for the bachelorette party.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过他们大多是新来的。我觉得她是为单身派对找来的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yeaaaaaaah but idk if that’s a good idea. I don’t think the guards will let you in :X{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是————啊，不过我不知道这样好不好。我觉得守卫不会放你进来的 :X{/i}

lines.en: : {i}They’re on high alert so that nobody’s special day gets interrupted if you know what I mean :3{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}他们现在高度戒备，免得谁的大日子被打断——你懂我意思吧 :3{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I probably COULD convince them if you wanted to come hang out in my room with me. But getting you to the spa just isn’t going to happen.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果你想来我房间陪我，我大概还说服得了他们。但要把你弄进温泉区，那是不可能的事。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Which is probably good for you tbh since I don’t think you’d want to see the shape Nee-sama is in right now lol.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}说实话这对你大概也是好事，因为我觉得你不会想看到姐姐大人现在是什么惨状 哈哈。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You’ve trained her well, big bro! She can really take a beating, huh?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你把她调教得真好啊，大哥！她可真扛得住折腾，对吧？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Why are you taking so long to respond?{/i}
: {i}Want some more pictures? :D Everyone’s too distracted to notice me taking them, I think.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}想要更多照片吗？:D 我觉得所有人都太投入了，根本不会注意到我在拍。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Except for all the guys in line lol{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}除了那些排队的家伙 哈哈{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yeah, Mom hired like twenty I think so they’re all just queued up waiting to stick it in one of Nee-sama’s holes.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}对，我妈大概雇了二十个，所以他们全都排着队，等着往姐姐大人的某个洞里插。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then Mom cleans them up afterward and I just hang out in the corner being eye candy.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}然后妈再把他们清理干净，我就在角落里当个养眼的花瓶。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I can tell a few definitely want to fuck me but....idk :3 I don’t want to get in the way of the party.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我看得出来有几个绝对想操我，但是……不知道 :3 我不想破坏派对的气氛。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Idk. Should I do it? I haven’t slept with a staff member since high school lol{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不知道。我要不要做？我从高中以后就没跟工作人员睡过了 哈哈{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I just can’t do this anymore. Tell your sister the wedding is off and that I don’t want anything to do with her.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我真的受不了了。告诉你姐姐，婚礼取消，我不想再和她有任何关系。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What about me? I didn’t do anything wrong{/i}
: {i}Marry me instead. She and I almost the same size now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那就娶我吧。她和我现在的身材差不多大了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I can have the dress modified by the end of the day.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我今天之内就能把裙子改好。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Cause you know I would never do this. You know I’m not a cheater. I love you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}因为你知道我绝不会做这种事。你知道我不会背叛你。我爱你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I had to do this. I’m saving you. Look at her. Look at the one you chose next to the one you didn’t.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我必须这么做。我是在救你。看看她。看看你选的那个，再看看你没选的那个。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Choose me instead. Love me. MAKE love to me. I won’t betray you. I’ll be your girl. I’ll be your everything.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}选我吧。爱我。和我做爱。我不会背叛你。我会当你的女人。我会成为你的一切。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Do it or you’ll regret it. You’ll really regret it. I mean it, Akira.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}照做吧，不然你会后悔的。你真的会后悔。我是认真的，Akira。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Just don’t expect a response for the next two hours :D{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}只是接下来两个小时别指望我回消息 :D{/i}
